{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Satin blouse, tailored fit, knee-length hemline, deep emerald green (#046307), silk blend.
Pleated wool-blend midi skirt, A-line cut, midi length, charcoal grey (#36454F), heavy wool with a subtle texture.
Structured blazer, single-breasted cut, hip-length, navy blue (#000080), fine worsted wool.
Pointed-toe pumps, slim silhouette, ankle-high instep, black leather (#000000).

This ensemble strikes the perfect balance between elegance and comfort for an upscale evening dinner. The emerald blouse provides a vibrant focal point that catches the warm artificial restaurant lighting, while the charcoal pleated skirt adds texture and sophistication without appearing too stiff. Topped with a navy blazer, the outfit ensures you remain appropriately dressed within the "smart" formality band even if the temperature drops slightly. Completing the look with classic black pumps ties everything together seamlessly, creating a polished yet approachable silhouette ideal for a romantic date."}
